title: Chaldean Oracles
subtitle: Hands up and answer the question. A delicate badge will be given to the best student.

trails.title: Trail ① Open Sandwich
trails.description: A greasy piece of paper. It seems to have wrapped some food with rich grease.

content.text: No, you are not awake yet. You are still drowned in this mire of meditation—sticky, swampy, and dark.
Where am I?

branch.text: Welcome to nihility, Ms. Too Many Questions. You might be in an ocean, a well, the base of a ring finger ... whatever.
At that "warm invitation," you are rewarded with some mold-like bruises on your legs. "The paramecia" think this gift will force you to give in.
But for you, the invisible wounds are much more severe.
Don't worry. They are not gentle at all, but neither are you benign.

content.text: Is this my memory?

branch.text: Memory? Good try! The logic you pride yourself on continues to serve you properly. It allows you to make some good deductions here, like a biologist analyzing the cause of a humpback appearing in a swamp.
But the answer will disappoint you, unfortunately. This is just a dream, an illusion they shoved into your head. These people are very familiar with using coercive power.

content.text: They are ...?

branch.text: A group of people in gowns. Their gowns are made of white polyester and are over knee-length. There are seven, namely No. 1 to No. 7.
Probably only those odd-number guys are here. Or maybe No. 4 or 6 is also with them ... Damn it, I don't care.
What matters is that your classmate is among them. No, not the gentle and loyal one who always stands by your side.
It is the other one—the one with indifferent outlines that makes her look like a refined machine.
Let's skip her first name and only pay attention to her glorious family name, like what most people did.
Like sherry cask whiskies to the alcoholic, Upmann Cedar Aged Robusto Cameroon to smokers ... and the Mesmers to the arcanists.

content.text: I see ... boujee.

branch.text: Ha Ha Ha, you smart-ass. Love your humor. Yeah, you are right, boujee!
Long ago, long long ago, you might have had the chance to experience such a period.

At that time, humans just made their decision to live without prayers, and that's also the beginning of the long-term cooperation between Laplace and those ... heh, oh, "scholars," as they called themselves.

content.text: What do they do?

branch.text: Anything mystical. When they sit there and point at you with an iron stick, you'll pass out. When they put an iron ring around your neck, you'll feel burnt ...

You must be familiar with all these freaky tricks, because you are surrounded by freaky tricksters, like that little girl who protects others with her glass dipping pen or that floating apple dancing in the air.

content.text: The Mesmers know how to suffocate the flames of consciousness; they help you free fall internally to the bottom of the abyss ... as you are now.
It's really hard finding an arcanist who can freely master such skill. As you know, scarcity causes tragedy.
That was the start of her nightmare: when the Child Labor Law was turned into a piece of wrinkled paper to wrap the sandwich.

The young daughter of the Mesmer family was led to a room when she was 12. Before she stepped in, she had sensed the messy magnetic field on the other side of the door, thanks to her acute perception.
Compared to humans, arcanists are much more emotionally vulnerable. It won't take much to overwhelm them and force them to regress to animals.
The Mesmers are merciful and professional. They will never turn away any patient who comes to them for treatment.
... By then, you should realize the wrapping paper was never protecting the sandwich, but the hand.
The mustard from an unknown bottle, the squeezed meatloaf, and rusty lettuce leaf, all were crushed and fell out from between the bread.
Just like the chaotic noises and the raspy screaming that fill her ears ... This filth contaminated the little girl's hands and corrupted the white polyester.

branch.text: Hmm, it is indeed a good time for silence.

content.text: Now you've noticed those exposed wounds on the machine, those marks from repeated washing and adjustments.
Well, the traumata from childhood is usually hard to forget.
Those memories are engraved in our heart and run through our veins ... Eventually, they contaminate every single neuron with mucous snot.
Since then, every inch of growth is an extension of pain. New bones will be eroded and the condition can't be cured by cellular renewal.
Both you and her are familiar with this.
Okay, take your suitcase. Now it's time ... Get lost!

trails.title: Trail ② A Dream Ⅰ
trails.description: It's black and sharp. It's hopping around.

items.text: Nouvelles et Textes pour rien
Chaldea Oracles

What arcanists regard to be more important is the knowledge from another pathway, which is often known as Gnosis. Compared with mankind's knowledge gained from reasoning, what are the features of Gnosis?
Sonetto.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Miss, the features of Gnosis are: one, it can not be verified by an independent third party; and two, it is impossible to be comprehended through reasoning.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Exactly. And that's also one of the reasons that the knowledge of the study of arcanum is hard to be accepted by the academic world.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: The academic research is required to be open to the public and can pass the independent tests, but the unpredictability of arcanum will lead the arcane researches to "methodological agnosticism."

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Thus, all the trainings and the scientific stabilizing appliances that the school provided for you is to overcome the instability of your arcane skill, in order to insure the peace and stability of human world.

items.speaker: All Students
items.text: May the peace be with us.
Urgh ... I was almost quick enough to answer that question. How could, how could she be so fast …

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Next question. After the fall of the Roman Empire, the number of arcanists, along with the related literature, had reduced correspondingly. Who can tell us the history of that time in brief?
Miiiss! Miiiiiiiiss!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I-I ... Miss, I know this one!

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Sonetto.
Aww …

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: As the Roman Empire declined, some arcanists were tempted by their irrational side of their nature and applied Magia Naturalis in warfare and disputes over interests, which irritated the Church and other powers of religion.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: At that time, people in Europe widely considered arcanum to be the paganism "that collaborates with the demons", hence the trials against arcanists.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: In response, arcanists struck back fiercely. However, due to their spontaneous character and the unpredictability of their whereabouts, their communication was unsuccessful during the fight …

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Both sides struggled in repeated battles. In the end, mankind, jointly led by both their religious and secular leaders, prevailed.
That can't be ... That's not how Grandpa told me …
Miss! She's wrong. I know, I know the right answer!

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Alright. Give it a try, Matilda.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: For what I know, it wasn't arcanists who started the war! The attack on Constantinople was waged by lordships in Western Europe to ransack the capital for resources and the literature of arcanum.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: The nursery rhyme my grandpa sang for me tells me all about it!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: And! Long ago, arcanists weren't called by this name ...

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: They were once gifted philosophers, diviners, or doctors ... until they were put on the labels of "pagans," "freaks," and "witches" and isolated by their people …

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: They were entirely forgotten. The next time people saw them, they had this new name—arcanists.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Inspiring. Do you remember its name?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Err ... Grandpa never told me that …

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: How about the melody? Could you present several lines for the class?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Let me think. It was like ...*humming* Emm, that's not it.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: That's weird ... I-I can't remember it ...

items.speaker: Student A
items.text: Haha! Don't remember a thing but still feel confident enough to answer the question. Shame on you, little thing!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I was even humming the rhyme last night! It just ...

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Sit down please, Matilda.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Sonetto is correct.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Matilda, you have just transferred here. It may take you some time to get used to our curriculum.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: A rhyme can be used in studying folklore, but it's still different from a formal historical intelligence.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Class, please turn to the last question of the test.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: After the Ottoman Empire seized control over Constantinople, Georgios Gemistos, a member of our Sharan Commune, also an arcanist and philosopher of the Roman Empire, traveled to Florence.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: He brought one classical literature of ancient Theurgy into the city, which sparked discussion and later brought about the annual humanists gathering—the Chaldean Conference, where the study of arcanum was debated over its use for mankind development.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Who knows the name of this work brought by Gemistos?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Miiiss, me, me!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Miss, please!! I know this one. I do know!!!
Her eyes fall on the desk next to Sonetto. There is a short wall made of books on the desktop.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Vertin, do you know the answer to this question?

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Vertin?
The instructor walks down from the podium.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: ... Vertin. She is absent again?

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Miiiiss, I know the answer!

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: It is Chaldean Oracles!
TO BE CONTINUED…
